high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing outdoors in front of an elegant, multi-story house at dusk or early evening. The individual is wearing a white dress with black trim and gold buttons, and they have long blonde hair that is slightly tousled. They are holding their hair back with one hand, which is adorned with a ring. The house behind them has a classic architectural style with multiple levels, large windows, and a prominent balcony on the upper floor. The exterior of the house is illuminated by warm, ambient lighting, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere.
